posts.title: Human Adaptation Beyond Diagnosis: Applying the Trauma Ecology Integration Model™

summary_en: A free 90-minute live webinar from Revolve Recovery, presented by Georgina Smith, PhD. It introduces the Trauma Ecology Integration Model: viewing trauma responses as adaptive rather than only pathological, integrating the model into clinical assessment, and building deeper therapeutic alliances and more sustainable recovery pathways. Held Friday 4 December 2026, 09:00-10:30 Pacific Time (01:00-02:30 Hong Kong/Macau time on Saturday 5 December), live online via TPN.health, free of charge, in English, with advance registration required. Carries 1.5 CE hours. Aimed at psychologists, social workers, counsellors, marriage and family therapists, addiction professionals and other behavioral health professionals.
summary_zh: Revolve Recovery 免費 90 分鐘網上講座，由 Georgina Smith 博士主講，介紹創傷生態整合模式：將創傷反應理解為適應而非單純病理、把模式融入臨床評估、加深治療聯盟並建立可持續的復元路徑。2026 年 12 月 4 日（星期五）美西時間 9:00–10:30 舉行（香港／澳門時間 12 月 5 日星期六凌晨 1:00–2:30），全程線上直播（TPN.health），費用全免，全程英語，須預先報名。可獲 1.5 CE 學分。對象為心理學家、社工、輔導員、婚姻家庭治療師、成癮輔導員及其他行為健康專業人員。
